greeting: Kel Sandren regards you without hurry. (Crosswind Courier of the Concordant Hub)

nodes.npcText: Kel is twenty-two, talks fast, makes friends in transit, takes pride in never having lost a parcel. Cousin to Taro Sandren but with no interest in fighting.
I am Kel Sandren, Crosswind Courier of the Concordant Hub. fast, friendly, occasionally lets slip a piece of route gossip

playerOptions.text: Tell me more about the hub.

nodes.npcText: The Unburned Court holds. The Ring of Doors opens only for those the hub will still name. Violence ends at the moss.
